title: Ham & Cheese Quesadilla
description: Crisp tortilla with melty cheese and diced ham.
substitutions: Use turkey lunch meat instead of ham.

steps.text: Fill tortilla with cheese and ham.

cookSteps.text: Warm {{butter}} butter or oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Put {{tortilla}} tortilla in the skillet. Sprinkle {{cheese}} cheese over one half, then add {{ham}} diced ham.
Fold the tortilla over and cook 2–3 minutes, until the bottom is golden.
Flip carefully and cook another 1–2 minutes, until the cheese is melted.
Move to a plate, let it sit 1 minute, then cut and eat.

title: 15-Minute Chickpea Tomato Skillet
description: Warm garlicky chickpeas in tomato sauce for toast or rice.

steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves and cook 30 seconds.
Add 2 cans drained chickpeas, 1 can diced tomatoes, 1/2 teaspoon Italian seasoning, and 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Simmer 8–10 minutes, stirring once or twice, until thickened.

title: Creamy Tomato Tortellini Soup
description: A cozy tomato soup with cheese tortellini and a little cream.

steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a medium pot.
Add 1 can crushed tomatoes, 3 cups broth, and 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning; bring to a simmer.
Add 9 ounces cheese tortellini and simmer according to package timing, usually 5–7 minutes, until tender.
Stir in 1/2 cup heavy cream and heat 2 minutes without boiling hard.

title: Black Bean & Corn Quesadillas
description: Crisp tortillas filled with beans, corn, and melted cheese.

steps.text: Mix 1 can drained black beans, 1 cup corn, and 1/2 teaspoon taco seasoning.
Divide the bean mixture and 1 1/2 cups shredded cheese over half of each of 4 tortillas; fold closed.
Cook quesadillas in a dry skillet over medium heat 2–3 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese melts.
